text:
samira: Draft PR up to change audit log examples to use tenant_hash and add a JS SDK migration snippet. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/819 (draft). Need SOC2-friendly wording and legal signoff.
eli: paste the current snippet so i can swap it.
samira: current example in docs: ```json {\"tenant_id\": \"org42\", \"actor\": \"max@example.com\", \"event\": \"update\"} ```
noah: recommend we replace with tenant_hash and call out pseudonymization via salted HMAC-SHA256. Also include a short retention sentence.
tara-legal: Legal prefers explicit wording: "Tenant identifiers in audit logs are pseudonymized using a salted HMAC-SHA256 (tenant_hash). Mapping tables, if retained, are access-restricted and access to them is audited." Please mention KMS/HSM for salt storage and default retention.
samira: proposed doc text: "Audit logs record tenant identifiers as tenant_hash values derived using a secret-salted HMAC-SHA256. Mapping tables, if any, are access-restricted and access is audited. Audit exports are encrypted at rest. Default retention is 90 days; customers may configure export.retention_days." Thoughts?
eli: good. Add a small JS snippet and a one-line migration note to the changelog.
noah: JS snippet idea: show HMAC with salt from KMS and a comment: do not log raw tenant ids.
ci-bot: Preview build for PR 819: https://deploy.previews.redwood/819; build passed; link-check found one broken anchor in api-reference#audit-exports (fixed).
samira: added JS snippet to PR:
```javascript
// compute tenantHash using HMAC-SHA256 with secret salt retrieved from KMS/HSM
const crypto = require('crypto');
const raw = 'tenant:acme';
const salt = await getSaltFromKms(); // retrieve salt from KMS/HSM
const hmac = crypto.createHmac('sha256', salt).update(raw).digest('hex');
await client.audit.logEvent({ tenantHash: hmac, actor: null, event: 'update' });
// NOTE: do not include raw tenant identifiers in logs or exports
```
tara-legal: please replace "getSaltFromKms()" comment with explicit "retrieve salt from KMS/HSM" in the snippet. Also request a one-line FAQ: "Why tenant_hash?" -> reduce PII in logs and ease SOC2 auditing.
eli: added FAQ and the changelog entry under migration notes v2.1. CI green after nav fix.
tara-legal: LGTM. Keep phrasing conservative.
samira: merging now. :shipit: thanks everyone.
noah: follow-up: recommend adding enterprise migration support note for customers with on-prem mapping tables.
samira: will follow up in a separate PR. closing thread.
